notes: P03 baseline fidelity adapters for ACNS (SoK: Evidence Boundaries of Attestation in Tool-Using AI Systems): run_baseline(baseline_id,case,ctx)->Outcome over the four EVIDENCE-BOUNDARY reference classes B0-attestation-only, B1-receipt-without-binding, B2-timestamp-only, B3-evidence-boundary-aware. SoK framing honored (novelty_contract section 1): the baselines are analytic classifiers over synthetic evidence-claim records (synthetic-acns-2027, _smoke_fixtures.py literals; no PHI/PII, no network, no clock, no provider), not systems, and each returns a structured EvidenceBoundaryVerdict (granted lattice level L0-L4, ACCEPT/REJECT, reason code, per-claim gap codes from the pre-registered register G1-G9 of the threat model). Executed witnesses (adversarial tests): B0 fails to detect the receipt-quoted-as-execution downgrade (G2) and accepts an unbound claim; B1 accepts a receipt bound to a different claim (G4 transplant); B2 accepts an unbound claim on timestamp freshness alone (G6) and the downgrade; B3 detects all three and grants a capped level. Constant-allow stub refused (UNKNOWN_BASELINE on both baseline_id and forged ctx.arm_id); unknown record -> NOT_RUN_EXTERNAL (retriable, never counted as acceptance); malformed input -> MALFORMED_CASE fail-closed.
